findings.title: Lithuanian login `loginTotpStep1` value replaced with Italian text
findings.description: The changed value is `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. The previous Lithuanian text was dropped, so Lithuanian users will see Italian on the TOTP setup page. The same key in the other locales was changed to the correct language.

findings.title: Lithuanian account `totpStep1` value replaced with Italian text
findings.description: The new value `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, not Lithuanian. This is the same copy-paste slip as the login bundle above.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account `totpStep1` uses Traditional Chinese characters
findings.description: The `messages_zh_CN` file is Simplified Chinese, but the new value `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The Simplified form would be 在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：.

findings.title: Mismatched prefix and suffix ranges can throw in the "Illegal HTML" message builder
findings.description: The prefix loop and the suffix loop can overlap on the same characters. For example, if `value` is `aa` and `sanitized` is `a`, `start` becomes 1 and `end` becomes 1. Then `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` becomes `substring(1, 0)`, which throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of adding the diagnostic message. The fix is to cap `end` so that `end <= min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`.
